mapper.sql: e.id, e.owner_id, e.parent_id, e.entry_kind AS kind, e.name, e.created_at, e.updated_at, e.deleted_at, o.storage_bucket AS bucket, o.storage_object_key AS object_key, COALESCE(o.size_bytes, 0) AS size_bytes, o.mime_type, COALESCE(s.is_starred, 0) AS starred, COALESCE(tags.tags_json, '[]') AS tags_json, 0 AS shared

LEFT JOIN file_object o ON o.entry_id = e.id LEFT JOIN user_file_state s ON s.entry_id = e.id AND s.user_id = e.owner_id LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ft.entry_id, CONCAT( '[', GROUP_CONCAT(JSON_QUOTE(t.name) ORDER BY t.name SEPARATOR ','), ']' ) AS tags_json FROM file_tag ft JOIN tag t ON t.id = ft.tag_id JOIN file_entry tagged_entry ON tagged_entry.id = ft.entry_id WHERE tagged_entry.owner_id = #{ownerId} GROUP BY ft.entry_id ) tags ON tags.entry_id = e.id
mapper.select:
SELECT FROM file_entry e
WHERE e.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND e.parent_id IS NULL AND e.entry_kind = 'FOLDER' AND e.deleted_at IS NULL LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM file_entry e
WHERE e.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND e.id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT FROM file_entry e
WHERE e.owner_id = #{ownerId}
AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
ORDER BY e.created_at

SELECT FROM file_entry e
WHERE e.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL AND e.entry_kind = 'FILE' ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC, e.id DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT FROM user_file_state starred_state JOIN file_entry e ON e.id = starred_state.entry_id AND e.owner_id = starred_state.user_id
WHERE starred_state.user_id = #{ownerId} AND starred_state.is_starred = 1 AND e.deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY e.updated_at DESC, e.id DESC

WITH RECURSIVE ancestor_chain AS ( SELECT id, parent_id, 0 AS depth FROM file_entry WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND id = #{id} UNION ALL SELECT parent.id, parent.parent_id, child.depth + 1 FROM file_entry parent JOIN ancestor_chain child ON parent.id = child.parent_id WHERE parent.owner_id = #{ownerId} ) SELECT , chain.depth FROM ancestor_chain chain JOIN file_entry e ON e.id = chain.id
WHERE chain.parent_id IS NOT NULL ORDER BY chain.depth DESC

SELECT parent_id, COUNT(*) AS item_count FROM file_entry WHERE owner_id = #{ownerId} AND parent_id IN
#{parentId}
AND deleted_at IS NULL
GROUP BY parent_id

SELECT COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN e.entry_kind = 'FILE' THEN o.size_bytes ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS used_bytes, COALESCE(SUM(e.entry_kind = 'FILE'), 0) AS file_count, COALESCE(SUM(e.entry_kind = 'FOLDER'), 0) AS folder_count FROM file_entry e LEFT JOIN file_object o ON o.entry_id = e.id WHERE e.owner_id = #{ownerId} AND e.deleted_at IS NULL
